policy: Each entry names exact locked versions. A version change drops the review and the package becomes a release blocker again until it is reviewed. A not-distributed decision keeps the package in the inventory and SBOM; it only removes it from the release gate because no MathOS release file contains it.

reviews.reason: GitHub Copilot CLI is not bundled. @github/copilot-sdk looks the CLI up at run time, and a compiled MathOS uses the CLI the user installed (packages/models/src/protocols/copilot-sdk.ts).
reviews.evidence: Bun.build metafiles for apps/tui/src/cli.ts and apps/desktop/host/host.ts list no @github/copilot input, and the compiled executables do not contain the GitHub Copilot CLI License text.

reviews.reason: Signing helper of @vscode/vsce, the extension packaging tool that runs only at build time.
reviews.evidence: The VS Code extension bundle (apps/vscode-extension/src/extension.ts) and every other release bundle have no npm package inputs from @vscode/vsce or @vscode/vsce-sign.

reviews.reason: Node-only dependencies of exceljs through unzipper. The desktop front end resolves exceljs to its browser build (dist/exceljs.min.js), which does not include unzipper or these packages.
reviews.evidence: The Vite module list of the desktop production build contains none of binary, buffers, chainsaw, traverse or unzipper.
